Example
rows: GET /feed?cursor=(ts,id)&limit=20: stable when new items arrive
Idempotency-Key header + unique index → retries are safe
user_id comes from the JWT; never trust {user_id} in the request
/v1/… or header; add optional fields only

blocks.text: "REST with resources from our entities: POST /bookings with an idempotency key, cursor-paginated GET /bookings. User identity comes from the auth token."
Spending 15 minutes on endpoint shapes is a classic way to run out of time for the deep dives.

items: Name resources after your core entities.
Accept an Idempotency-Key on every mutating call.
Take the user's identity from the auth token, never from the body.
Return 202 and a job ID for long work.

blocks.text: "Three endpoints cover the requirements; writes take an idempotency key, lists use cursor pagination, and identity comes from the token."
